page.layout: One page of text in a single column of Hebrew lexicon entries. Running head with Hebrew letters at the top, page number 194 at the top right. Catchword "Ad" at the lower right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: נָכְרִי m. Exter, Alienus, Extraneus: plurale, נָכְרִים Fem. נׇכְרִיָּה plur. נׇכְרִיּוֹת.
מַכָּר m. Notus. הַכָּרָה f. Agnitio.
נְכָאת נֹכֲת m. Aromata: Thesauri, Gaza.
נָמַל Circumcidit: Succisus fuit. Niphal נִמּוֹל Circumcidi.
נָסַג Apprehendit. Hiphil הִסִיג Movit, Amovit. Hophal הָסַג: Vide & סוג.
נָסָא Tollere, quomodo cum נָשָׂא convenit. Pihel נִסָּה Tentavit, Probavit, Expertus fuit, Periculum fecit.
נָסַח Avellere, Evellere, Exstirpare. Niphal נִסַּח Evelli.
נָסַךְ Fudit, Affudit, Effudit, Libavit. Inunxit: item, Expandere, Obtegere, Obducere. Niphal נִסַּךְ Inungi. Pihel נסך Effudit, Libavit. Chald. Infin. לְנַסָּכָה

page.notes: The Hebrew vowel points on several entries are uncertain at this scan resolution and may differ slightly from print. The top right page number is 194. Show-through and edge damage on the page margins were ignored.
